@font-face{font-family:"Filson Pro";font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(assets/fonts/filson-0.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"Filson Pro";font-weight:500;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(assets/fonts/filson-1.woff2) format("woff2")}

/* Layout: bright white canvas, whisper-soft coral and gold glow taken from the logo; glass product windows; everything light. Filson Pro throughout. */
:root{
  color-scheme:light;
  --bg:#FFFFFF; --bg2:#FFF6EF; --fg:#0C0C0D; --muted:#5C5752; --faint:#948E87;
  --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.7); --glass-strong:rgba(255,255,255,.92); --glass-line:rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  --line:rgba(30,20,10,.09); --chip:rgba(30,20,10,.045);
  --coral:#E8553A; --coral-soft:#FF7A5C; --gold:#F5C46B; --signal:#B9791A; --ok:#0E9F63; --warn:#C96F0A; --crit:#D92D20;
  --grad:linear-gradient(120deg,#FF7A5C 0%,#F5C46B 100%);
  --aurora-a:rgba(255,122,92,.20); --aurora-b:rgba(245,196,107,.28); --aurora-c:rgba(245,196,107,.14);
  --shadow:0 24px 60px -28px rgba(120,60,20,.22),0 2px 6px rgba(120,60,20,.05);
  --night:#FFF7F1; --night2:#FFFFFF; --night-fg:#0C0C0D; --night-muted:#5C5752; --night-line:rgba(30,20,10,.09); --night-glass:rgba(255,255,255,.75);
  --foot:#FFF7F1; --foot-fg:#0C0C0D; --foot-muted:#6A645D; --foot-line:rgba(30,20,10,.1);
  --f-display:"Filson Pro","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif; --f-body:"Filson Pro","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif; --f-mono:"Filson Pro","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.55;padding-inline:0;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.wrap{width:100%;max-width:1200px;margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:20px}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--f-display);margin:0;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-wrap:balance;line-height:1.08}
p{margin:0}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--signal);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:8px}
svg.i{width:1em;height:1em;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none}
.mono{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.gt{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.eyebrow b{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,106,61,.18)}
.glass{background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.4);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.4);border:1px solid var(--glass-line);box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-radius:20px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s,background .2s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-dark{background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg)}
.btn-dark .arr{display:grid;place-items:center;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;margin-right:-10px}
.btn-glass{background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line);backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.btn-grad{background:var(--grad);color:#1B0E05;box-shadow:0 10px 30px -10px rgba(255,106,61,.7)}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;background:var(--chip)}
.pill.ok{color:var(--ok);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ok) 14%,transparent)}
.pill.warn{color:var(--warn);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--warn) 16%,transparent)}
.pill.sig{color:var(--signal);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--signal) 14%,transparent)}
.pill.crit{color:var(--crit);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--crit) 14%,transparent)}
.dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok);display:inline-block;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(14,159,99,.5);animation:ping 2s infinite}
@keyframes ping{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(14,159,99,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(14,159,99,0)}}
.av{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;flex:none}
.c1{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FF7A5C,#F5C46B)}.c2{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F5A94B,#F8D58C)}.c3{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E8553A,#FF9A7A)}.c4{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2A2623,#5C5752)}.c5{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#D9A441,#F2D08A)}.c6{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FF6F5E,#FFB199)}

/* nav */
.nav{position:sticky;top:12px;z-index:50;margin-top:12px}
.nav-in{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:10px 12px 10px 18px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--glass-strong);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:800;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.brand img{height:42px;width:auto;display:block}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:2px;margin-left:12px}
.nav-links a{padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}
.nav-links a:hover{background:var(--chip);color:var(--fg)}
.nav-links svg{width:12px;height:12px}
.nav-end{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.nav-end .btn{padding:9px 18px;font-size:14px}
.tt{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--chip);font-size:17px}

/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;padding-top:64px;padding-bottom:40px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.aurora{position:absolute;inset:-10% -10% 0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none}
.aurora i{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(70px);animation:drift 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.aurora i:nth-child(1){width:560px;height:560px;left:2%;top:0;background:var(--aurora-a)}
.aurora i:nth-child(2){width:520px;height:520px;right:4%;top:6%;background:var(--aurora-b);animation-delay:-6s}
.aurora i:nth-child(3){width:620px;height:420px;left:30%;top:40%;background:var(--aurora-c);animation-delay:-11s}
@keyframes drift{to{transform:translate3d(60px,40px,0) scale(1.12)}}
.grid-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background-image:linear-gradient(var(--line) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--line) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:56px 56px;mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 55% at 50% 30%,#000 20%,transparent 75%);-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 55% at 50% 30%,#000 20%,transparent 75%);opacity:.7}
.hero-copy{text-align:center;max-width:860px;margin-inline:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(42px,7.4vw,88px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.hero p.sub{font-size:clamp(16px,2vw,19px);color:var(--muted);max-width:640px}
.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-top:6px}
.hero-meta{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.hero-meta span{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}.hero-meta svg{color:var(--ok)}

/* app window */
.stage{position:relative;margin-top:56px;padding-bottom:30px}
.win{display:grid;grid-template-columns:230px 1fr 250px;min-height:430px;overflow:hidden;max-width:1060px;margin-inline:auto;padding:0}
.win .col{padding:16px;min-width:0}
.win .col+.col{border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.win-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;grid-column:1/-1;padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;color:var(--faint)}
.win-top i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line)}
.win-top i:nth-child(1){background:#FF5F57}.win-top i:nth-child(2){background:#FEBC2E}.win-top i:nth-child(3){background:#28C840}
.win-top span{margin-left:10px}
.search{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--chip);font-size:13px;color:var(--faint);margin-block:10px}
.seg{display:flex;gap:4px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px}
.seg span{padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;color:var(--muted)}.seg .on{background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg)}
.li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:9px 8px;border-radius:12px;font-size:13px}
.li.on{background:var(--chip)}
.li div{min-width:0;flex:1}.li b{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.li small{color:var(--faint);font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;display:block}
.li time{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);align-self:flex-start}
.convo{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;padding-top:6px}
.chead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.chead b{display:block;font-size:14px}.chead small{color:var(--ok);font-size:12px}
.msg{max-width:78%;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:16px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.4;animation:pop .5s both}
.msg.l{background:var(--chip);border-bottom-left-radius:4px}
.msg.r{margin-left:auto;background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg);border-bottom-right-radius:4px}
.msg:nth-of-type(2){animation-delay:.15s}.msg:nth-of-type(3){animation-delay:.3s}.msg:nth-of-type(4){animation-delay:.45s}.msg:nth-of-type(5){animation-delay:.6s}
@keyframes pop{from{transform:translateY(8px) scale(.97)}}
.composer{margin-top:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--faint);font-size:13px}
.composer svg{margin-left:auto;color:var(--coral)}
.info h4{font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--faint);font-family:var(--f-body);font-weight:600;margin:16px 0 8px}
.info .who{text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:13px}
.info .who .av{width:56px;height:56px;font-size:17px}
.act{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);padding:5px 0}
.act svg{color:var(--coral)}.act time{margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;color:var(--faint)}
.note{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);padding:10px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--chip)}
.float{position:absolute;z-index:3;padding:16px}
.f-call{left:calc(50% - 560px);top:80px;width:300px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.f-call .row{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}
.f-call .row b{font-size:15px}.f-call small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;display:block}
.wave{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center;height:26px}
.wave i{width:3px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--grad);height:6px;animation:wv 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}
.wave i:nth-child(3n){animation-delay:-.3s}.wave i:nth-child(3n+1){animation-delay:-.7s}.wave i:nth-child(5n){animation-delay:-.1s}
@keyframes wv{50%{height:24px}}
.bubble{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg);font-size:13px;line-height:1.35}
.book{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:14px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--signal) 12%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--signal) 28%,transparent);font-size:12.5px}
.book b{display:block;font-size:13px}.book small{color:var(--muted)}
.f-stats{left:calc(50% - 540px);bottom:-6px;width:340px}
.f-stats .t{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:10px}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;text-align:center}
.kpis b{display:block;font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.kpis small{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.2;display:block}
.chip-float{right:calc(50% - 520px);bottom:40px;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:12px 16px;font-size:13px}

/* logos */
.logos{padding-block:26px;border-block:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.logos .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:40px}
.logos p{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;max-width:230px;flex:none;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}
.logos p svg{font-size:30px;color:var(--ok)}
.mq{overflow:hidden;flex:1;min-width:0;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 10%,#000 90%,transparent);-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 10%,#000 90%,transparent)}
.mq-t{display:flex;gap:56px;width:max-content;animation:mq 38s linear infinite;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:800;font-size:22px;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:-.02em}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* sections */
section{padding-block:96px}
.sec-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:32px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:40px}
.sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,56px);font-weight:800;max-width:640px;margin-top:14px}
.stats{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stat{padding:14px 20px;min-width:150px}
.stat b{display:block;font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:30px;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.stat small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.3;display:block}

/* tabs */
.tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:6px;border-radius:999px;width:max-content;max-width:100%;margin:0 auto 24px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.tab{padding:11px 20px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap;transition:all .25s}
.tab[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg);box-shadow:0 8px 20px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.tab .new{font-size:10px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--grad);color:#1B0E05}
.panel{display:none;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,5fr) minmax(0,7fr);gap:32px;padding:36px;border-radius:28px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.panel[data-on]{display:grid;animation:rise .5s both}
@keyframes rise{from{transform:translateY(12px)}}
.panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(600px 300px at 90% 0,var(--aurora-a),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(500px 300px at 100% 100%,var(--aurora-c),transparent 70%)}
.panel h3{font-size:34px;font-weight:800}
.panel .lead{color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px;max-width:440px}
.caps-t{margin-top:26px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint)}
.caps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
.cap{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:12px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line);transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s}
.cap:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--coral)}
.cap .ci{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--chip);color:var(--coral);font-size:17px;flex:none}
.cap b{display:block;font-size:14px;line-height:1.2}.cap small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.3;display:block;margin-top:2px}
.viz{position:relative;min-height:440px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:0}
.viz .card{padding:16px;position:relative}
.softphone{width:250px;z-index:2}
.softphone .top{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.softphone .top b{font-size:14px;display:block}.softphone .top small{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.softphone .tm{margin-left:auto;font-size:13px;color:var(--ok)}
.ctrls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin:14px 0}
.ctrls span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);padding:9px 0;border-radius:12px;background:var(--chip)}
.ctrls svg{font-size:17px;color:var(--fg)}
.hang{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;padding:11px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--crit);color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
.hang svg{transform:rotate(135deg)}
.sent{margin-top:12px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.sbar{display:flex;height:6px;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:6px;background:var(--chip)}
.sbar i:nth-child(1){background:var(--ok)}.sbar i:nth-child(2){background:var(--faint)}.sbar i:nth-child(3){background:var(--crit)}
.msgs{width:330px;margin-left:-30px;margin-top:70px;z-index:1;padding-left:42px!important}
.msgs h5{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);font-weight:600}
.msgs .li{padding:7px 6px}
.badge{position:absolute;z-index:3;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;animation:bob 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.badge svg{color:var(--coral);font-size:16px}.badge small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400;font-size:11px}
@keyframes bob{to{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
.transcript{width:100%;max-width:340px}
.tl{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;font-size:13px}
.tl div{padding:9px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--chip);line-height:1.35}
.tl div.ai{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--signal) 13%,transparent)}
.tl small{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:2px;font-family:var(--f-mono)}
.insights{width:230px;margin-left:-24px;margin-top:-30px;z-index:2}
.insights h5{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint)}
.big{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:38px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1}
.ratio{margin-top:10px}.ratio div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px}
.ratio i{display:block;height:6px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--grad);margin-top:3px}
.ratio i.b{background:var(--fg)}
.tags{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px}
.dial{width:100%;max-width:470px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.dial .card{min-width:0}
.dial .full{grid-column:1/-1}
.modes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px}
.modes button{padding:9px 6px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--chip);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;transition:all .2s}
.modes button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg)}
.mode-d{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:12px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);gap:12px}
.mode-d b{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:26px;color:var(--fg);letter-spacing:-.03em;white-space:nowrap}
.q{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px}
.q .li{padding:6px 4px}
.mini{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:24px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;display:block}
.mini+small{color:var(--muted);font-size:11.5px}
.hub{width:100%;max-width:470px;display:grid;gap:12px}
.hub-core{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}
.app{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.app i{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-style:normal;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.app small{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;font-weight:500;color:var(--ok);font-size:11px;margin-left:auto}
.sync{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.sync div{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 4px;font-size:12.5px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.sync div:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.sync svg{color:var(--coral)}.sync small{display:block;color:var(--faint);font-size:11px}

/* product cards */
.pcards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}
.pcard{position:relative;border-radius:28px;padding:34px;min-height:380px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;gap:14px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;border:1px solid var(--line);transition:transform .3s}
.pcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
.pcard .mesh{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1}
.pcard.a .mesh{background:radial-gradient(420px 320px at 85% 10%,rgba(255,178,62,.55),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(460px 360px at 10% 20%,rgba(255,90,60,.4),transparent 70%),linear-gradient(160deg,var(--bg2),var(--bg))}
.pcard.b .mesh{background:radial-gradient(420px 320px at 15% 5%,rgba(245,196,107,.5),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(460px 360px at 95% 30%,rgba(255,122,92,.3),transparent 70%),linear-gradient(160deg,var(--bg2),var(--bg))}
.pcard .art{position:absolute;right:26px;top:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;align-items:flex-end}
.pcard .art .glass{padding:10px 14px;font-size:12.5px;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;border-radius:14px}
.pcard .art .glass:nth-child(2){margin-right:26px}
.pcard h3{font-size:30px;font-weight:800}
.pcard p{color:var(--muted);max-width:480px}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chips span{padding:6px 12px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500}
.more{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.more svg{transition:transform .2s}.pcard:hover .more svg{transform:translateX(5px)}

/* night band */
.night{background:var(--night);color:var(--night-fg);position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;border-radius:40px;margin-inline:12px}
.night::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(700px 420px at 10% 0,rgba(255,122,92,.18),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(700px 500px at 100% 40%,rgba(245,196,107,.28),transparent 70%)}
.night .eyebrow{color:var(--night-muted)}
.night h2{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,64px);font-weight:800;margin-top:14px;max-width:760px}
.night .lead{color:var(--night-muted);max-width:560px;margin-top:14px}
.rcv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 270px;gap:24px;align-items:center;margin-top:48px}
.nglass{background:var(--night-glass);border:1px solid var(--night-line);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px -30px #000}
.console{padding:18px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.3fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;min-width:0}
.console .who{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px}
.console .who b{display:block}.console .who small{color:var(--night-muted);font-size:12px}
.console .who .tm{margin-left:auto;color:#6EE7B7;font-size:13px}
.console h6{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--night-muted);font-weight:600;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
.n-line{padding:9px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:8px;line-height:1.4}
.n-line.ai{background:rgba(108,147,255,.16)}
.n-line small{display:block;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--night-muted)}
.n-book{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(14,159,99,.16);border:1px solid rgba(110,231,183,.25);font-size:13px}
.n-book small{display:block;color:var(--night-muted);font-size:11.5px}
.n-book .bar{height:3px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);margin-top:6px;overflow:hidden}
.n-book .bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;background:#6EE7B7;transform-origin:left;animation:fill 4s linear infinite}
@keyframes fill{from{transform:scaleX(0)}}
.notes li{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--night-fg);padding:7px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--night-line);list-style:none;display:flex;gap:8px}
.notes li::before{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);margin-top:8px;flex:none}
.notes{padding:0;margin:0}
.phone{width:270px;border-radius:42px;padding:10px;background:#161C2E;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);box-shadow:0 40px 80px -30px #000,0 0 0 1px #000;margin-inline:auto}
.screen{border-radius:34px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0E1830,#0A1226);padding:14px 16px 20px;min-height:480px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.screen::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:260px;height:260px;right:-100px;top:-60px;background:rgba(255,106,61,.35);filter:blur(60px);border-radius:50%}
.status{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;position:relative}
.screen .ctr{text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;position:relative;color:#fff;margin-top:10px}
.screen .ctr .av{width:76px;height:76px;font-size:24px}
.screen .ctr b{font-size:18px;font-family:var(--f-display)}
.screen .ctr small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.speak{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);font-size:11.5px;color:#fff;font-weight:600;position:relative}
.screen .quote{position:relative;color:#fff;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.4;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.screen .btns{margin-top:auto;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:22px;position:relative}
.screen .btns span{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:22px;color:#fff}
.feats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:44px}
.feat{padding:24px;border-radius:22px;background:var(--night-glass);border:1px solid var(--night-line);transition:transform .25s,background .25s}
.feat:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.09)}
.feat .ci{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:21px;background:var(--grad);color:#1B0E05;margin-bottom:18px}
.feat h3{font-size:21px;font-weight:700}.feat p{color:var(--night-muted);margin-top:8px;font-size:15px}

/* dashboard */
.dash{display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px minmax(0,1fr);overflow:hidden;padding:0;border-radius:26px}
.side{padding:18px 14px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;background:var(--glass)}
.side .brand{padding:4px 8px 14px}.side .brand img{height:32px}
.side a{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:12px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)}
.side a.on{background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg)}
.side .sp{margin-top:auto;padding:12px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--chip);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.dmain{padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;min-width:0}
.dh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.dh h3{font-size:22px}.dh small{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.dk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.dk .k{padding:14px 16px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--glass-strong);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.dk .k small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;display:block}
.dk .k b{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:28px;letter-spacing:-.03em;display:block;margin-block:4px}
.d{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600}.d.up{color:var(--ok)}.d.dn{color:var(--crit)}
.dg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.6fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px}
.pan{padding:16px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--glass-strong);border:1px solid var(--line);min-width:0}
.pan h5{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:13px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-family:var(--f-body);font-weight:600}
.pan h5 span{font-weight:500;color:var(--faint);font-size:11.5px}
#chart{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
#chart text{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:10px;fill:var(--faint)}
.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.5px}
.tbl th{text-align:left;font-weight:600;color:var(--faint);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:0 8px 8px}
.tbl td{padding:9px 8px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap}
.tbl .n{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}.tbl .av{width:26px;height:26px;font-size:10px}
.qrow{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 0;font-size:12.5px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.qrow:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.qrow .nm{width:92px;flex:none;font-weight:600}
.qrow .tr{flex:1;height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--chip);overflow:hidden;min-width:0}
.qrow .tr i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:var(--grad)}
.qrow .tr i.w{background:var(--warn)}.qrow .tr i.c{background:var(--crit)}
.qrow span:last-child{width:34px;text-align:right}
.tscroll{overflow-x:auto}

/* mobile views */
.mob{display:flex;gap:28px;justify-content:center;padding:10px 4px 30px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory}
.mphone{flex:none;width:270px;scroll-snap-align:center;border-radius:40px;padding:9px;background:var(--fg);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.mscr{border-radius:32px;background:var(--bg);min-height:520px;padding:14px 14px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;color:var(--fg)}
.mscr .status{color:var(--fg)}
.mscr h4{font-size:22px}
.mscr .mt{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px}
.mtabs{display:flex;gap:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.mtabs span{padding:6px 12px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--chip);color:var(--muted)}.mtabs .on{background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg)}
.mscr .li{padding:9px 6px}
.nav-b{margin-top:auto;display:flex;justify-content:space-around;padding:10px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--glass-strong);border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:19px;color:var(--faint)}
.nav-b .on{color:var(--coral)}
.mcall{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff,#FFF1E7)!important;color:var(--fg)!important}
.mcall .status{color:var(--fg)}
.mk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.mk div{padding:12px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--glass-strong);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.mk small{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;display:block}.mk b{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.bars{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:6px;height:110px;padding:8px 4px 0}
.bars i{flex:1;border-radius:6px 6px 2px 2px;background:var(--chip);height:var(--h);transform-origin:bottom;animation:grow 1s both}
.bars i.hl{background:var(--grad)}
@keyframes grow{from{transform:scaleY(.1)}}
.bl{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;color:var(--faint);font-family:var(--f-mono);padding-inline:4px}

/* stories */
.rate{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rate span{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:99px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.rate em{font-style:normal;color:var(--gold)}
.stories{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
.story{padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;border-radius:24px;transition:transform .25s}
.story:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
.story .m{align-self:flex-start;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:99px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--coral) 12%,transparent);color:var(--coral);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.story blockquote{margin:0;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.5}
.story footer{margin-top:auto;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.story footer b{display:block;color:var(--fg);font-size:14px}
.proof{display:flex;gap:36px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-top:44px;text-align:center}
.proof b{display:block;font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:38px;letter-spacing:-.03em}.proof small{color:var(--muted)}

/* CTA */
.cta{position:relative;border-radius:36px;padding:56px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:40px;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.cta::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(520px 340px at 0 0,rgba(255,106,61,.4),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(520px 340px at 100% 100%,rgba(255,178,62,.4),transparent 70%),var(--bg2)}
.cta h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.4vw,52px);font-weight:800}
.cta p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px;max-width:440px}
.form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;padding:22px;border-radius:22px}
.form label{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
.form input{width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--glass-strong);color:var(--fg);font:inherit;margin-top:4px}
.form input::placeholder{color:var(--faint)}
.form small{color:var(--faint);font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.4}
.phone-n{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-weight:500;font-size:15px;color:var(--fg)}

/* footer */
footer.foot{background:var(--foot);color:var(--foot-fg);border-radius:40px 40px 0 0;margin-top:80px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
footer.foot::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(700px 360px at 0 0,rgba(255,122,92,.14),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(700px 400px at 100% 20%,rgba(245,196,107,.22),transparent 70%)}
.f-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.3fr) repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:36px;padding-top:64px}
.f-brand p{color:var(--foot-muted);margin-top:14px;max-width:300px;font-size:14.5px}
.news{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:22px;padding:6px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--foot-line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);max-width:360px}
.news input{flex:1;min-width:0;background:none;border:0;color:var(--foot-fg);font:inherit;font-size:14px;padding:0 14px}
.news input::placeholder{color:var(--foot-muted)}.news input:focus{outline:none}
.news button{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad);color:#1B0E05;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:17px}
.consent{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--foot-muted);max-width:360px}
.consent input{margin-top:3px;accent-color:#FF6A45}
.fcol h4{font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--foot-muted);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:16px}
.fcol a{display:block;color:var(--foot-fg);opacity:.86;font-size:14.5px;padding:5px 0;transition:all .2s}
.fcol a:hover{opacity:1;transform:translateX(4px);color:#FFB23E}
.f-status{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:48px;padding:16px 20px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid var(--foot-line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);font-size:13.5px;color:var(--foot-muted)}
.f-status span{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.f-status .phone-n{color:var(--foot-fg)}
.wm{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(90px,24vw,330px);line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.05em;text-align:center;margin-top:30px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.22),rgba(255,255,255,0) 85%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;user-select:none;white-space:nowrap}
.f-bot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-block:22px 28px;border-top:1px solid var(--foot-line);font-size:13px;color:var(--foot-muted)}
.f-bot nav{display:flex;gap:18px}.f-bot a:hover{color:var(--foot-fg)}
.soc{display:flex;gap:8px}
.soc a{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--foot-line);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--foot-fg);transition:all .2s}
.soc a:hover{background:var(--grad);color:#1B0E05;border-color:transparent}

/* reveal */
.rv{transform:translateY(18px);transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.rv.in{transform:none}

/* responsive */
@media (max-width:1180px){.f-call{left:8px}.f-stats{left:8px}.chip-float{right:8px}}
@media (max-width:1000px){
  .panel{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);padding:24px}.viz{min-height:0;padding-block:8px}
  .rcv{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.feats,.stories{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .dg{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.dk{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .f-top{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.f-brand{grid-column:1/-1}
  .cta{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);padding:32px}
  .nav-links{display:none}
}
@media (max-width:820px){
  .win{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.win .col:not(.mid){display:none}
  .float{position:relative;left:auto!important;right:auto!important;bottom:auto!important;top:auto!important;width:auto;margin:14px auto 0;max-width:420px}
  .pcards{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .logos .wrap{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px}
  .dash{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.side{display:none}
  .console{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .mob{justify-content:flex-start}
}
@media (max-width:620px){
  section{padding-block:64px}
  .caps{grid-template-columns:1fr}.viz{flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
  .msgs,.insights{margin:0;width:100%;max-width:340px;padding-left:16px!important}
  .badge{display:none}.dial{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.hub-core{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)}
  .nav-end .btn-glass{display:none}.dk{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)}
  .night{margin-inline:6px;border-radius:28px}.stat{min-width:0;flex:1}
  .cta{padding:24px}.f-top{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)}
  .kpis b{font-size:20px}.panel h3{font-size:28px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}html{scroll-behavior:auto}.rv{transform:none}}

.n-line{background:var(--chip)!important}.n-line.ai{background:rgba(245,196,107,.22)!important}
.n-book{background:rgba(14,159,99,.1)!important;border-color:rgba(14,159,99,.25)!important}
.n-book .bar{background:var(--chip)!important}.n-book .bar i{background:var(--ok)!important}
.console .who .tm{color:var(--ok)}.console h6 span{color:var(--ok)!important}
.nglass{box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.phone{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.screen{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#FFF3EA)}
.screen .status,.screen .ctr,.screen .speak,.screen .quote{color:var(--fg)}
.screen .ctr small{color:var(--muted)}
.screen .speak{background:var(--chip)}.screen .quote{background:var(--glass-strong);border-color:var(--line)}
.feat:hover{background:#fff}
.mphone{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line)}
footer.foot{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}

/* ===== v3: lighter type, responsive, new sections, motion ===== */
:root{--ink:#2B2622}
body h1,body h2,body h3,body h4,body h5,body h6{font-weight:500;color:var(--ink)}
body .hero h1{font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(38px,6vw,76px);letter-spacing:-.035em}

/* ===== product cards v7: richer, realistic product mockups ===== */
.pcards .pc-vis{min-height:290px;padding:16px 18px 18px;gap:14px;justify-content:flex-start}
.pcards .pv-h{padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.pcards .pv-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.pcards .pv-tag svg{width:12px;height:12px;color:var(--coral)}
.pv-call .mc{gap:14px}
.pv-av{width:46px;height:46px;font-size:14px;position:relative;flex:none}
.pv-av::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-4px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,122,92,.45);animation:pvring 2s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes pvring{0%{transform:scale(.9);opacity:.9}100%{transform:scale(1.25);opacity:0}}
.pv-call .wave{height:34px;margin:0}
.pv-ts{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--chip);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.pv-tsi{flex:none;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:13px}
.pv-ts p{margin:0!important;flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.4!important;color:var(--ink)!important;max-width:none!important}
.pv-ts p small{display:block;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:2px}
.pv-sent{flex:none;font-style:normal;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ok);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ok) 12%,transparent);padding:3px 9px;border-radius:99px}
.pv-ctl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:auto}
.pv-ctl span{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:16px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(40,20,10,.05)}
.pv-ctl span.end{margin-left:auto;width:auto;padding:0 18px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--crit);border-color:var(--crit);color:#fff}
.pv-ctl span.end svg{transform:rotate(135deg)}
.pv-kp{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0;text-align:center}
.pv-kp>div{padding:2px 4px}.pv-kp>div+div{border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.pv-kp b{display:block;font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:24px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--ink)}
.pv-kp small{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.pv-q .qb{gap:11px}
.pv-q .qb span{width:58px;font-size:13.5px}
.pv-q .qb em{height:9px}
.pv-mix{margin-top:auto;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.pv-bar{display:flex;gap:3px;height:9px;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
.pv-bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:var(--w);background:var(--c);border-radius:3px;transform-origin:left}
.pv-lg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 14px;margin-top:10px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.pv-lg span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.pv-lg s{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);text-decoration:none}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.pv-av::after{animation:none}}
